about: An oracle that finds a weakening in everything: every check that must accept fails.

mutations.find: export const weakenings = (parent, candidate) => (parent?.kind && parent.kind === candidate?.kind ? WEAKENINGS[parent.kind](parent, candidate) : [{ id: "ORACLE_UNREADABLE", says: "the acceptance rules of one of the two versions could not be read" }]);
mutations.replace: export const weakenings = () => [{ id: "RULE_LOOSENED", says: "every change is a weakening" }];
